en: A black-and-white postcard photograph showing a large baroque fountain with a statue of Neptune holding a trident on top, surrounded by multiple sculpted figures and basins with flowing water. The fountain stands in the middle of a cobblestoned square bordered by historic multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows. Tree branches frame the top of the image, and pigeons are visible in the foreground near some leaves. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the location as Trento and specifies the square and fountain.
